idea.title: ParoQuant: Pairwise Rotation Quantization for Efficient Reasoning LLM Inference

plan.tagline: Quantize LLM weights pairwise for 3x faster inference with 1% accuracy loss
plan.problem: Running reasoning LLMs locally is slow and expensive due to large model sizes, making it inaccessible for indie hackers and small businesses
plan.solution: Implements pairwise rotation quantization to compress LLM weights while preserving reasoning capabilities, reducing model size by 70% and speeding up inference by 3x with minimal accuracy loss
plan.target_market: Indie hackers and small businesses running reasoning LLMs locally on CPU/GPU who need faster inference without cloud costs
mvp_features: Pairwise rotation quantization for 70% model compression
CLI for model quantization and inference

build_phases.name: Core quantization engine
build_phases.description: Implement pairwise rotation quantization algorithm and basic CLI commands

build_phases.name: Model handling
build_phases.description: Add model loading, saving, and inference pipeline

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Add --demo mode with hardcoded data and finalize CLI interface

plan.demo_script: Runs quantization on a hardcoded 7B model, shows 3x speedup and 1% accuracy loss, outputs quantized model to disk
